name: Foundation Models
blurb: Every released model, by modality and purpose, with full release, licence, architecture, context, pricing, performance, and safety metadata.

built.name: Large Language Models
built.detail: General purpose text models, by family, size, and licence.

built.name: Reasoning Models
built.detail: Models trained or tuned to work through problems step by step before answering.

built.name: Multimodal Models
built.detail: Models that accept and produce more than one modality.

built.name: Vision Models
built.detail: Image understanding, detection, segmentation, and document vision.

built.name: Image Generation Models
built.detail: Text to image and image editing models.

built.name: Audio and Speech Models
built.detail: Speech recognition, synthesis, and audio understanding.

built.name: Embedding Models
built.detail: Vector representations for search, clustering, and retrieval.

built.name: Coding Models
built.detail: Models trained for code generation, review, and repair. Membership is the Hub's own code tag on text-generation models, ranked by all-time downloads.

built.name: Small Language Models
built.detail: Compact models that trade capability for cost and latency. The cut is a declared parameter count of four billion or fewer from safetensors metadata; models that do not publish a count cannot appear.

built.name: On-device and Edge Models
built.detail: Models packaged to run on phones, laptops, and embedded hardware. Membership is the GGUF tag, the format llama.cpp and most local runtimes load, ranked by downloads.

built.name: Robotics Models
built.detail: Vision-language-action and control models for physical systems.

built.name: Scientific Models
built.detail: Models for chemistry and biology: molecular property prediction, protein language models, and scientific NER. Membership is the Hub's chemistry and biology tags.

built.name: Medical Models
built.detail: Clinical, imaging, and biomedical models, by the Hub's medical tag. Reference material about models, not medical advice.

built.name: Legal Models
built.detail: Models tuned for legal text: contracts, statutes, and case language, by the Hub's legal tag. Reference material about models, not legal advice.

built.name: Financial Models
built.detail: Models tuned for financial text and market language, by the Hub's finance tag. Reference material about models, not investment advice.

built.name: Model Metadata Standard
built.detail: The full record kept for every model: release and licence, parameters and architecture, context and training data, distribution, pricing and performance, and safety.
